description: Traffico pubblico locale - Km percorsi e validazioni is a dataset listed in Comune di Bologna open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Comune di Bologna. Dati mensili relativi al traffico pubblico locale. Sono riportati i chilometri percorsi e le validazioni effettuate. I dati sono messi a disposizione da SRM l'agenzia per la mobilità e il trasporto pubblico del Comune di Bologna e della Città Metropolitana di Bologna. Coverage: Bologna. The portal files it under Trasporti. The portal shows 87 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2026-03-31 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-comune-bologna-it-portal.
